The '''''Krakana's Claw''''' was a modified [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] that was flown by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Irackant]] around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The ship was constructed from a stripped-down version of the GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat in order to track down Imperial war criminals. Irackant modified the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] environmental systems to give it a more moist atmosphere, as well as fitting the ship with a cell, enhancing the starship's automated systems and fitting the ''Krakana's Claw'' with a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher holding 16 heavy torpedoes.
